details:
libsoup is an HTTP client/server library for GNOME. It uses GObjects and the glib main loop, to integrate well with GNOME applications, and also has a synchronous API, for use in threaded applications.

Security Fix(es):

libsoup library has a replay attack vulnerability in HTTP digest authentication handling, allowing attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms. This vulnerability involves CWE-323 type security issues.(CVE-2026-3099)

A vulnerability was found in GNOME libsoup (version unknown). It has been rated as critical. Using CWE to declare the problem leads to CWE-918. The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL, but it does not sufficiently ensure that the request is being sent to the expected destination. Impacted is confidentiality, integrity, and availability. There is no information about possible countermeasures known. It may be suggested to replace the affected object with an alternative product.(CVE-2026-3632)
